origin.description: A run of two spaces ends a field. The last end is missing so the field runs to the end of the line.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: A run of two spaces ends a field. The last end is missing so the field runs to the end of the line.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
spec <- fwf_empty(readr_example("fwf-sample.txt"), col_names = c("name", "state", "ssn"))
paste(paste(spec$begin, collapse = ","), paste(ifelse(is.na(spec$end), "NA", spec$end), collapse = ","), paste(spec$col_names, collapse = ","), sep = ";")
